rationale.consistency: Idiomatic Go and flag usage, but reimplements discovery instead of building on gitindex.FindGitRepos, adds a unix-only flock file with no build tag, and the unconditional name-preservation silently changes zoekt-git-index naming for repos with an origin remote.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers root-as-repo, bare repos, worktree .git files and duplicate names; but no-root exits with an error and no usage text, a dry run still creates the index dir and lock file, and any walk error (e.g. permission denied) aborts the whole sync.
rationale.scope: Delivers sync/list/remove, lock and DryRun; however the gitindex change is an implicit behaviour change for existing callers rather than an opt-in, and Repository.Root is set but unused.
rationale.readability: Small, well-named functions with useful doc comments; help text is clear. Flag definitions duplicated verbatim in newSyncFlagSet and runSync hurt clarity.
rationale.robustness: Non-blocking flock is sound and released; but shard metadata read errors are swallowed silently, IndexGitRepo is invoked twice per repo, a shadowed root yields an empty path in one error message, and one failing repo aborts pruning.
rationale.maintainability: Modular split across files, but the eight sync flags must be kept in sync in two places, and DryRun overloads the meaning of IndexGitRepo's bool return, a subtle contract future callers may miss.
